newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Kempen cuts ASM Litho to Underperformer.
newsitem.headline: Kempen cuts ASM Litho to Underperformer.

text.p: COMMENT: Underperformer (cut from Outperformer) - Profit estimates lowered after company visit and trip to Silicon Valley as supply glut and price battle loom. ASML is one of world's three main producers of wafer stepper machines for chips manufacturing, but capacity will be 1,700 at year-end and demand estimated at 900-1,100. Chips industry in a slump, hurting investment climate while large shareholders in ASML (Philips, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell) may look for opportunities to sell.

Product mix not strong enough to offset negative effect. In worst case scenario share price could fall to 1.5 times book value, which is what happened to chips equipment makers in last downcycle in 1991/92.
Although industry faces long-term growth, 1997 is likely to be a down-cycle year and with 1.5 price/book ratio in mind this could price shares at 25-30 guilders.
